issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in CLI operations: read-modify-write without locking allows data

key_changes: Added transaction() context manager to TodoStorage for exclusive locking
Added separate .lock file to avoid conflicts with data file
Wrapped all CLI read-modify-write operations (add, mark_done, mark_undone, remove) in transaction()
Implemented lock timeout with clear error messages
Lock is automatically released on context exit or process crash

risks_and_limitations: fcntl.flock is Unix-only; Windows would need msvcrt.locking or a different approach
Lock is advisory, not mandatory - other processes could bypass it
10 second default timeout may not be appropriate for all use cases
